assembly/archetypes/coding.yaml:
version: 1
type: coding
description: Mock engineering workspace
agents:
  - wopal.md
skills:
  - dev-flow
rules:
  - typescript.md
commands:
  - init.md
  - wopal/memo.md
plugins:
  ellamaka:
    - wopal-plugin
assembly/schemas/coding-space-schema.yam:
version: 1
runtime:
  path: .wopal-space
  files:
    - template: STRUCTURE.md
      target: STRUCTURE.md
    - template: REGULATIONS.md
      target: REGULATIONS.md
    - template: memory/USER.md
      target: memory/USER.md
  dirs:
    - path: memory
      keep:
        - .gitkeep
    - path: logs
      keep:
        - .gitkeep
    - path: .tmp
space:
  files:
    - template: root-AGENTS.md
      target: AGENTS.md
    - template: gitignore
      target: .gitignore
  dirs:
    - path: projects
      keep:
        - .gitkeep
    - path: docs
      keep:
        - .gitkeep
.env.example:
# Mock environment template
# Copy to .wopal/.env and fill in your values.

# WOPAL_LLM_API_KEY=sk-your-key-here
WOPAL_PLUGIN_LOG_LEVEL=info
